welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to {bot_name}
welcome.body: I turn GitHub contributions into friendly momentum — with a local AI, no paid API keys, and no message content sent to a third party.
welcome.steps:
1. `{prefix}link <github-username>` — connect your GitHub work
2. `{prefix}challenge` — get one small, useful next step
3. `{prefix}leaderboard` — celebrate what the community has built
welcome.hint: Type `{prefix}help` anytime. I speak English, 中文 and 日本語 — switch with `{prefix}language`.
help.title: **{bot_name}** · help
help.body:
**Get started**
`{prefix}start` — a quick tour
`{prefix}link <github-username>` — connect GitHub
`{prefix}challenge` — a personal next step

**Community**
`{prefix}leaderboard` — top contributors
`{prefix}sentiment <text>` — reflect on the tone of a message
`{prefix}ask <question>` — ask the local AI

**Settings**
`{prefix}language en|zh|ja` — change language
`{prefix}privacy` — see or delete your data
`{prefix}status` — bot health
`{prefix}about` — version and credits

Tip: in a DM, or when mentioned, you can also just talk to me naturally.
help.admin:
**Admin**
`{prefix}set_repo owner/repo` — choose the tracked repository
`{prefix}refresh` — refresh GitHub stats now
help.footer: Local AI via Ollama · open source · MIT licensed.
error.generic: Something went wrong on my side. Please try again in a moment — the details are in the bot logs.
error.unknown_command: I don't know `{command}` yet. Try `{prefix}help`, or ask a question with `{prefix}ask ...`.
error.invalid_usage:
That command needs a little more information.
Usage: `{usage}`
error.admin_only: That one is for community admins. You can still use `{prefix}help`, `{prefix}challenge`, or `{prefix}leaderboard`.
error.rate_limited: You're moving fast! Please wait about {seconds}s and try again. 🌱
error.ai_disabled: Local AI is switched off right now. You can still use challenges, the leaderboard and GitHub commands.
error.ai_unavailable: I can't reach the local Ollama model right now. Your data is safe — please try again shortly.
error.ai_timeout: The local model took too long to answer. Try a shorter question, or ask an admin to check Ollama.
error.ai_token_limit: The local model used its whole answer budget before replying. Try a shorter question, raise `OLLAMA_MAX_TOKENS`, or use a non-reasoning model such as `qwen2.5:3b`.
error.input_too_long: That message is a bit long for me ({length}/{limit} characters). Could you shorten it?
error.github_not_configured: GitHub isn't connected yet. An admin can add `GITHUB_TOKEN` and run `{prefix}set_repo owner/repo`.
error.github_repo_missing: No repository is selected yet. An admin can run `{prefix}set_repo owner/repo`.
error.github_api: GitHub didn't answer as expected. Please try again shortly; the bot will keep retrying in the background.
error.not_linked: Link your GitHub account first with `{prefix}link <github-username>`, then I can help with that.
error.repo_not_found: I couldn't open `{repo}`. Check the spelling and make sure the token can read it.
error.private: That action is only available in a direct message, to keep your data private.
repo.set: Repository set to **{repo}**. I'll start tracking contributions there. 🌱
link.success: Linked **{github}**! I found **{commits} commits / {issues} issues / {prs} pull requests**, worth **{points} points**. Welcome aboard! 🎉
link.already: You're already linked to **{github}** — {points} points and counting.
link.already_other: You're linked to **{current}**. Ask an admin to unlink that account before linking **{new}**.
link.failed: I couldn't find GitHub activity for **{github}**. Double-check the username (not the display name) and try again.
challenge.title: 🎯 Your next challenge
challenge.requires_link: Link your GitHub account first (`{prefix}link <github-username>`), then I'll tailor a challenge to your work.
challenge.fallback: Try this: {activity}. Small, specific steps beat grand plans — and someone in the community will notice. 🌱
challenge.fallback_review: Leave one kind, specific comment on a small pull request this week. Name what works and ask one gentle question.
challenge.fallback_issue: Open one small, well-described issue with a clear reproduction and the outcome you hope for. Clear reports are a real contribution.
challenge.fallback_pair: Invite one person to pair for 30 minutes on a task that has been sitting around. Share the context first, then decide together.
challenge.activity_summary: {commits} commits, {issues} issues and {prs} PRs so far
leaderboard.title: 🏆 Community leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No one has linked a GitHub account yet. Be the first: `{prefix}link <github-username>`.
leaderboard.footer: Points: commit ×{commit_points} · issue ×{issue_points} · PR ×{pr_points}. Every contribution counts.
sentiment.usage:
Usage: `{prefix}sentiment <text to reflect on>`
Tip: paste a message or describe the tone you're worried about.
sentiment.title: 🫶 Tone check
sentiment.disclaimer: This is a best-effort reflection, not a judgment about people or a mental-health assessment.
sentiment.fallback: I can't reach the local model, so here's a simple read: {tone}. {tip}
sentiment.positive: the tone looks constructive and warm
sentiment.negative: the tone may feel tense or discouraging to others
sentiment.tip.positive: Keep naming the behaviour you appreciate — it makes collaboration easier.
sentiment.tip.negative: Try separating the problem from the person, and ask one clarifying question before replying.
sentiment.tip.neutral: Adding a little context or a clear next step can make the message land better.
ask.usage: Ask me anything, e.g. `{prefix}ask how do I review my first PR?`
ask.offline: My local brain is offline right now. Try `{prefix}help` or ask again in a few minutes.
language.current: I'm speaking **{language}** with you. Switch anytime: `{prefix}language en`, `zh` or `ja`.
language.set: Done — I'll reply in **{language}** from now on. 🌍
language.invalid: I can speak English, 中文 and 日本語. Choose one: `{prefix}language en`, `zh` or `ja`.
privacy.title: 🔒 Your data, your call
privacy.body: I store only what this bot needs: your platform ID, display name, language choice, GitHub link, points and badges. I don't store your chat messages. AI replies are generated by the Ollama server you run.
privacy.optout: Opt out with `{prefix}privacy optout` — I'll only answer privacy and opt-in commands.
privacy.opted_out: You're opted out. I won't track or reply to community commands until you send `{prefix}privacy optin`.
privacy.optin: Welcome back. You're opted in again. 🌱
privacy.delete_confirm: To delete your profile, points link and settings, send `{prefix}privacy delete confirm`. This can't be undone.
privacy.deleted: Your profile is gone. Thanks for trying the bot — you're welcome back anytime.
privacy.help:
Privacy options:
`{prefix}privacy` — what I store
`{prefix}privacy optout` / `optin`
`{prefix}privacy delete confirm`
privacy.dm_only_delete: For safety, profile deletion is only available in a direct message. Please DM me.
status.title: 📊 Bot status
status.refresh_hint: Admins can run `{prefix}refresh` to update stats now.
about.body:
**{bot_name}** v{version} — free, open-source community momentum for GitHub.

• Local AI through Ollama (no paid API, no vendor lock-in)
• Works across Discord, Slack, Telegram, Matrix and any chat app via the bridge API
• English, 中文, 日本語
• MIT licensed — fork it, improve it, self-host it.
admin.help:
**Admin commands**
`{prefix}set_repo owner/repo` — choose the tracked repository
`{prefix}refresh` — refresh GitHub stats now
`{prefix}shutdown confirm` — stop the bot (only if enabled)
admin.refresh.running: Refreshing GitHub stats — this can take a moment. ⏳
admin.refresh.done: Stats refreshed. {updated} contributors checked, {points} new points awarded.
admin.shutdown.disabled: Remote shutdown is disabled. Stop the bot from the host (Ctrl+C, Docker, or your process manager).
admin.shutdown.confirm: Send `{prefix}shutdown confirm` if you really want to stop the bot.
admin.shutdown.done: Shutting down gracefully. See you soon! 👋
